statements.text: Idealism is the ontology that combines two propositions: phenomenal consciousness is irreducible, and everything else, the whole of nature, is reducible to one unitary, universal phenomenal consciousness.

sources.quote: the ontology of idealism is characterized by a combination of two propositions: (a) phenomenal consciousness is irreducible; and (b) everything else—the whole of nature—is reducible to a unitary and universal phenomenal consciousness
